core_meaning.primary_meaning: Abbas is an Arabic-origin name meaning “To frown, to be stern”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Abbas corresponds to the Arabic form عباس (ع ب س). Its core sense is lion; stern, frowning. ʿAbbās, from ʿabasa ('to frown, to be stern'); also associated with the lion. The source record's gloss 'Lion, Stern, Gritty' is partly folk etymology.
